title: 2012 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: A rectangular photograph is placed in a frame that forms a border two inches wide on all sides of the photograph. The photograph measures \(8\) inches high and \(10\) inches wide. What is the area of the border, in square inches?

solutions.text:
If we add \(2\) inches on each side, we add \(4\) inches total on both sides. This means that the dimensions of the outer part of the frame are \(12 \times 14.\) The area of this is \(12\cdot 14 = 168.\)

However, we must take out the area of the inner part of the frame which has area \(8 \cdot 10 =80.\)

Therefore, the total area is \(168-80=88.\)

Thus, the answer is E .
hints: Find the outside dimensions of the framed photograph.
Subtract the photograph area from the outside rectangle area.
